slice: P3 selected unmarked MATERIAL file-backed diffuse filename edit
scope: Unchanged captured modern-DXF MATERIAL source with complete diffuse and inferred normal tuples, diffuse source 1 and both filenames present; typed diffuse filename edit alone or composed with selected normal and diffuse scalar and matrix fields.

contract.operation: Bind exactly two outer group-3 fields around the inferred second group-42 boundary, preserve the normal filename unless separately edited, require unchanged file-backed diffuse source and use target-format strict UTF-8 encoding for changed filenames. Re-decode and match the represented output model.
contract.atomicity: Invalid UTF-8, NUL, excessive text, changed source/presence, conflicting raw fields, original source 0 and late mutations refuse without replacing the destination or caller state; corrected retry uses the same adapter.
contract.unqualified: Source 0 filename edits and changing source group 72, procedural coupling, native file resolution/rendering, other producer profiles and whole-document fidelity.

validation.focusedControls: Plain, UTF-8, caret, literal Unicode-escape and empty filenames under Compatible and RequireLossless target policies, each across four ASCII/binary input/output routes; simultaneous diffuse/normal filenames, scalars and matrices; invalid UTF-8, NUL, excessive size, source/presence and conflicting raw fields, source-0 refusal, late callbacks, sentinel rollback and corrected retries.
validation.chronology: Normal and ASan ran frozen code committed above; independent physical projection was refreshed against rebuilt shared normal adapter and library.

independentPeer.derivation: Separately authored AC1027 source with diffuse source 1, distinct normal/diffuse sentinels and producer specular code corrected to 76. The derived input removes unrelated EZDXF_META root and DICTIONARY/DICTIONARYVAR objects; selected MATERIAL tags match the original before document setup.
independentPeer.observations: Independent pre-setup physical-tag projection compared all 94 selected tags across UTF-8, caret and literal-escape edits in ASCII/binary. Only the first group 3 changed; target-specific text was decoded separately once.

limitations: The two filename roles and source=1 conditions apply only to the selected complete inferred tuple and matching captured owner; source 0 and other profiles remain unqualified.
Independent selected projection uses a derived source with unrelated objects removed and an explicit one-pass text decode; it does not prove automatic peer decoding or whole-document fidelity.
No native CAD file lookup or rendering, DWG parity, arbitrary source version or broad support claim follows; no drawing fixture is committed.
